# Daktronics Names Amar G Subash as Vice President of International Sales


BROOKINGS, S.D. – Oct. 21, 2026 – Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT), a recognized industry leader in digital display and control system technology, has named Amar G Subash vice president of international sales, effective October 21, 2026. Based in London, UK, Amar will lead international sales strategy and execution while building market expansion and partnership opportunities.


Amar brings more than two decades of global experience to Daktronics, with a track record of driving business growth, directing market strategy and building project pipelines across key market segments and regions. He most recently served as vice president and general manager for EMEA and India at HARMAN Professional Solutions and previously held a similar role for Asia-Pacific and India.


“As Daktronics pursues targeted international expansion, Amar brings proven leadership in key global markets,” said Ramesh Jayaraman, president and CEO of Daktronics. “I have worked with Amar for more than a decade, and his track record of accelerating profitable growth, knowledge and relationships in the AV industry, building strong teams and strengthening customer engagement will enable us to continue to deliver and expand the Daktronics value proposition to customers around the world.”


Jayaraman added, “Judd Guthmiller has served as vice president of international sales over the last several years, built a strong dedicated team, scaled the business, and expanded our presence in some of the most iconic sites in the world. Judd is a valued colleague; we wish him the very best as he leaves Daktronics to pursue a new chapter. Judd will play a key role in a smooth transition to Amar and ensure continuity for our customers, business partners and our team.”


“I’m excited to join Daktronics and lead its international sales organization,” said Amar. “The company has built a strong global presence across its business segments, and I look forward to working with our teams and partners worldwide to strengthen customer relationships, enter new markets and create new opportunities for sustained profitable growth.”


Earlier in his career, Amar served as general manager and chief financial officer for Tyco Fire & Security and as senior manager of finance for Lucent Technologies India. He began his career in finance and consulting before moving into general management. He holds a Bachelor of Commerce degree from Nagpur University and is a member of the Institute of Cost and Management Accountants of India. He also completed an executive management program at the Haas School of Business, University of California.


### ​About Daktronics


Daktronics helps its customers to impact their audiences throughout the world with large-format LED video displays, message displays, scoreboards, digital billboards, audio systems and control systems in sport, business and transportation applications. Founded in 1968 as a USA-based manufacturing company, Daktronics has grown into the world leader in audiovisual systems and implementation with offices around the globe. Discover more at[www.daktronics.com](https://www.daktronics.com/) .
